text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There they are... Looks like they're doing
well...
Perhaps I should get a little bit
closer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My oh my... Care to explain why you're
spying on
our underclassmen?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy, I know you can do it. Just
go up to
them and ask to join 'em.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What?! I would never dare to meddle so

obviously!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This is... Yes, this is merely surveillance! I
must
confirm whether or not they are
studying!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Those two were rather worried about
their
upcoming test, so I naturally took
notice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I refuse to have anyone in my entourage embarrass me with a failing grade.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure they'd like it better if you
called
them your "cute little juniors."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...This is why no one calls you cute.
